name: Aberrant Dragonmark
source: Eberron - Rising from the Last War
desc: +1 CON. A sorcerer cantrip and a sorcerer 1st-level spell cast through the mark once per short rest (CON). Casting it, you may roll a Hit Die: even = temp HP, odd = force damage to a random creature within 30 ft. Comes with a flaw.

name: Actor
desc: +1 CHA. Advantage on Deception/Performance to pass as someone else; mimic voices and sounds heard for 1 min (Insight vs your Deception to see through).

name: Adept of the Black Robes
source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen
prereq: 4th Level, Initiate of High Sorcery (Nuitari) Feat
desc: Needs Initiate of High Sorcery (Nuitari). One 2nd-level enchantment/necromancy spell, free once per long rest. When a creature within 60 ft fails a save against your damaging spell, spend Hit Dice up to the spell level and add their roll to the damage.

name: Adept of the Red Robes
source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen
prereq: 4th Level, Initiate of High Sorcery (Lunitari) Feat
desc: Needs Initiate of High Sorcery (Lunitari). One 2nd-level illusion/transmutation spell, free once per long rest. Prof bonus/long rest: an attack roll or ability check d20 of 9 or less counts as a 10.

name: Adept of the White Robes
source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen
prereq: 4th Level, Initiate of High Sorcery Feat
desc: Needs Initiate of High Sorcery (Solinari). One 2nd-level abjuration/divination spell, free once per long rest. Reaction when you or a creature within 30 ft takes damage: spend a slot, reduce it by slot-level d6 + your spell modifier.

name: Agent of Order
prereq: 4th Level, Scion of the Outer Planes (Lawful Outer Plane) Feat
desc: Needs Scion of the Outer Planes (lawful). +1 to any ability. Once per turn, on damaging a creature within 60 ft: +1d8 force and a WIS save or restrained until your next turn (prof bonus/long rest).

name: Alert
desc: +5 initiative, can't be surprised while conscious, and hidden attackers gain no advantage against you.

name: Artificer Initiate
desc: An artificer cantrip and 1st-level spell (INT), the spell free once per long rest; proficiency with one artisan's tool, usable as a focus.

name: Athlete
desc: +1 STR or DEX. Standing from prone costs 5 ft, climbing costs no extra movement, running jumps need only a 5 ft run-up.

name: Baleful Scion
prereq: 4th Level, Scion of the Outer Planes (Evil Outer Plane) Feat.
desc: Needs Scion of the Outer Planes (evil). +1 to any ability. Once per turn, on damaging a creature within 60 ft: +1d6 + prof necrotic and you heal that much (prof bonus/long rest).

name: Bountiful Luck
desc: Halfling. Reaction: an ally within 30 ft who rolls a 1 on an attack, check or save rerolls it; you can't use your own Lucky trait until the end of your next turn.

name: Cartomancer
desc: Card deck as focus; Prestidigitation as card tricks. After a long rest, store a 1-action spell from your class list (of a level you have slots for) in a card for 8 h; cast it from the card as a bonus action.

name: Charger
desc: After Dash, bonus action melee attack or shove; with 10 ft straight-line movement first, +5 damage or push 10 ft.

name: Chef
desc: +1 CON or WIS, cook's utensils. Short rest meal for 4 + prof creatures: +1d8 HP when spending Hit Dice. After a long rest or 1 h, prof-bonus treats (8 h): bonus action to eat for temp HP equal to prof bonus.

name: Cohort of Chaos
prereq: 4th Level, Scion of the Outer Planes (Chaotic Outer Plane) Feat.
desc: Needs Scion of the Outer Planes (chaotic). +1 to any ability. A natural 1 or 20 on an attack or save triggers a random chaotic flare (d4 table) until the end of your next turn.

name: Crossbow Expert
desc: Ignore loading on crossbows, no disadvantage for ranged attacks in melee, bonus action hand crossbow attack after attacking with a one-handed weapon.

name: Crusher
desc: +1 STR or CON. Once per turn a bludgeoning hit moves the target 5 ft; a bludgeoning crit gives all attacks against it advantage until your next turn.

name: Defensive Duelist
desc: Needs DEX 13. Reaction while wielding a proficient finesse weapon: add prof bonus to AC against one melee attack.

name: Divinely Favored
source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen
desc: A cleric cantrip, a 1st-level spell by alignment and Augury, each free once per long rest; holy symbol as focus.

name: Dragon Fear
desc: Dragonborn. +1 STR, CON or CHA. Spend a Breath Weapon use to roar: chosen creatures within 30 ft WIS save (DC 8 + prof + CHA) or frightened 1 min, new save when damaged.

name: Dragon Hide
desc: Dragonborn. +1 STR, CON or CHA. Unarmored AC 13 + DEX (shield allowed); retractable claws deal 1d4 + STR slashing as unarmed strikes.

name: Drow High Magic
desc: Drow. Detect Magic at will; Levitate and Dispel Magic once each per long rest (CHA).

name: Dual Wielder
desc: +1 AC while wielding a melee weapon in each hand, two-weapon fighting with non-light one-handed weapons, draw or stow two weapons at once.

name: Dungeon Delver
desc: Advantage on checks to find secret doors and on saves against traps, resistance to trap damage, fast pace costs no passive Perception.

name: Durable
desc: +1 CON. Hit Dice spent to heal restore at least twice your CON modifier (minimum 2).

name: Dwarven Fortitude
desc: Dwarf. +1 CON. When you take the Dodge action, spend a Hit Die to heal (die + CON).

name: Eldritch Adept
desc: Needs spellcasting or Pact Magic. Learn one Eldritch Invocation (prerequisites only if you are a warlock); swap it on level up.

name: Elemental Adept
prereq: The ability to cast at least one spell
desc: Needs spellcasting. Pick acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder: your spells ignore resistance to it and treat 1s on its damage dice as 2s. Repeatable.

name: Ember of the Fire Giant
source: Bigby Presents - Glory of the Giants
prereq: 4th Level, Strike of the Giants (Fire Strike) Feat
desc: +1 STR, CON or WIS, fire resistance. Replace one attack with a 15 ft fiery burst: DEX save, 1d8 + prof fire and blinded until your next turn on a fail (prof bonus/long rest).

name: Fey Touched
desc: +1 INT, WIS or CHA. Misty Step and one 1st-level divination/enchantment spell, each free once per long rest.

name: Fighting Initiate
desc: Needs proficiency with a martial weapon. Learn one fighter Fighting Style; swap it at each ASI level.

name: Flames Of Phlegethos
desc: Tiefling. +1 INT or CHA. Reroll 1s on fire spell damage; after a fire spell, flames wreathe you until your next turn: light 30 ft, 1d4 fire to creatures hitting you in melee.

name: Fury of the Frost Giant
source: Bigby Presents - Glory of the Giants
prereq: 4th Level, Strike of the Giants (Frost Strike) Feat
desc: +1 STR, CON or WIS, cold resistance. Reaction when hit by a creature within 30 ft: CON save, 1d8 + prof cold and speed 0 on a fail (prof bonus/long rest).

name: Gift of the Chromatic Dragon
desc: Bonus action: a weapon deals +1d4 acid/cold/fire/lightning/poison for 1 min (once per long rest). Reaction: resistance to one instance of those types (prof bonus/long rest).

name: Gift of the Gem Dragon
desc: +1 INT, WIS or CHA. Reaction when damaged by a creature within 10 ft: STR save, 2d8 force and pushed 10 ft on a fail (prof bonus/long rest).

name: Gift of the Metallic Dragon
desc: Cure Wounds free once per long rest (INT, WIS or CHA). Reaction when you or a creature within 5 ft is hit: +prof bonus to its AC against that attack (prof bonus/long rest).

name: Grappler
desc: Needs STR 13. Advantage on attacks against a creature you grapple; action to pin it (both restrained) with another grapple check.

name: Great Weapon Master
desc: Bonus action melee attack after a crit or a kill; before a heavy weapon attack, take -5 to hit for +10 damage.

name: Greater Dragonmark (UA)
prereq: 8th level, character must possess a dragonmark
desc: Needs a dragonmark and level 8. Intuition die grows one size, +1 to an ability set by the mark, and a set of mark spells, each free once per long rest.

name: Guile of the Cloud Giant
source: Bigby Presents - Glory of the Giants
prereq: 4th Level, Strike of the Giants (Cloud Strike) Feat
desc: +1 STR, CON or CHA. Reaction when hit: resistance to that damage and teleport 30 ft (prof bonus/long rest).

name: Gunner
desc: +1 DEX. Firearms proficiency, ignore their loading property, no disadvantage for ranged attacks in melee.

name: Healer
desc: Stabilizing with a healer's kit also restores 1 HP. Action, one kit use: heal 1d6 + 4 + the target's max Hit Dice, once per creature per rest.

name: Heavily Armored
desc: Needs medium armor proficiency. +1 STR, heavy armor proficiency.

name: Heavy Armor Master
desc: Needs heavy armor proficiency. +1 STR. In heavy armor, nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage is reduced by 3.

name: Infernal Constitution
desc: Tiefling. +1 CON, resistance to cold and poison, advantage on saves against being poisoned.

name: Initiate of High Sorcery
source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen
prereq: Dragonlance Campaign, Sorcerer or Wizard Class or Mage of High Sorcery Background
desc: Pick a moon of Krynn: a wizard cantrip and two 1st-level lunar spells, each free once per long rest (INT, WIS or CHA).

name: Inspiring Leader
desc: Needs CHA 13. 10-minute speech: up to six allies within 30 ft gain temp HP equal to your level + CHA, once per rest each.

name: Keen Mind
desc: +1 INT. Always know north and the hours to sunrise or sunset; perfect recall of the last month.

name: Keenness of the Stone Giant
source: Bigby Presents - Glory of the Giants
prereq: 4th Level, Strike of the Giants (Stone Strike) Feat
desc: +1 STR, CON or WIS, darkvision 60 ft (or +60). Bonus action rock throw: ranged spell attack 60 ft, 1d10 force, STR save or prone (prof bonus/long rest).

name: Knight of the Crown
source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen
desc: Needs Squire of Solamnia. +1 STR, DEX or CON. Bonus action: an ally within 30 ft makes a weapon attack as a reaction, +1d8 damage on a hit (prof bonus/long rest).

name: Knight of the Rose
source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen
desc: Needs Squire of Solamnia. +1 CON, WIS or CHA. Bonus action: a creature within 30 ft gains 1d8 + prof + your ability modifier temp HP (prof bonus/long rest).

name: Knight of the Sword
source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen
desc: Needs Squire of Solamnia. +1 INT, WIS or CHA. Once per turn on a weapon hit: WIS save or frightened until your next turn (prof bonus/long rest).

name: Lightly Armored
desc: +1 STR or DEX, light armor proficiency.

name: Linguist
desc: +1 INT, three languages, and ciphers others can't read without your help, an INT check (DC your INT + prof) or magic.

name: Lucky
desc: 3 luck points per long rest: roll an extra d20 for your attack, check or save (pick which counts), or against an attack on you.

name: Mage Slayer
desc: Reaction melee attack on a creature within 5 ft that casts a spell; your damage gives disadvantage on its concentration save; advantage on saves vs spells cast within 5 ft.

name: Magic Initiate
desc: Two cantrips and one 1st-level spell from one of the bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, wizard lists; the spell free once per long rest at its lowest level.

name: Martial Adept
desc: Two Battle Master maneuvers and one d6 superiority die (short rest); save DC 8 + prof + STR or DEX.

name: Medium Armor Master
desc: Needs medium armor proficiency. No Stealth disadvantage in medium armor; with DEX 16+ it adds up to +3 DEX to AC instead of +2.

name: Metamagic Adept
desc: Needs spellcasting or Pact Magic. Two Metamagic options and 2 sorcery points for them (long rest); swap an option at ASI levels.

name: Mobile
desc: +10 ft speed; Dash ignores difficult terrain; a creature you attack in melee can't make opportunity attacks against you that turn.

name: Moderately Armored
desc: Needs light armor proficiency. +1 STR or DEX, proficiency with medium armor and shields.

name: Mounted Combatant
desc: While mounted: advantage on melee attacks vs unmounted creatures smaller than the mount, redirect attacks on the mount to you, mount gets evasion on DEX saves.

name: Observant
desc: +1 INT or WIS, lip reading in known languages, +5 passive Perception and Investigation.

name: Orcish Fury
desc: Half-orc. +1 STR or CON. Once per short rest roll one extra weapon damage die on a hit; reaction weapon attack right after Relentless Endurance.

name: Outlands Envoy
prereq: 4th Level, Scion of the Outer Planes (The Outlands) Feat.
desc: Needs Scion of the Outer Planes. +1 to any ability. Misty Step and Tongues (no material), each free once per long rest.

name: Piercer
desc: +1 STR or DEX. Once per turn reroll one piercing damage die; piercing crits add one more damage die.

name: Planar Wanderer
prereq: 4th Level, Scion of the Outer Planes Feat
desc: Needs Scion of the Outer Planes. Pick acid, cold or fire resistance each long rest; DC 20 Arcana to force a portal open or shut for 1 h (3d8 psychic on a fail); sense nearby portals.

name: Poisoner
desc: Damage ignores poison resistance, coat weapons as a bonus action, poisoner's kit. 1 h + 50 gp: prof-bonus doses; a hit forces DC 14 CON save or 2d8 poison and poisoned until your next turn.

name: Polearm Master
desc: Glaive, halberd, quarterstaff or spear: bonus action butt-end attack (d4 bludgeoning). With those or a pike, creatures entering your reach provoke opportunity attacks.

name: Prodigy
desc: Half-elf, half-orc or human. One skill, one tool, one language, and expertise in one proficient skill.

name: Quicksmithing
desc: Two 1st-level ritual spells from any list as INT effects (learn more from schematics), quicksmith's tools, and Tiny clockwork devices that work for 24 h.

name: Resilient
desc: +1 to one ability and proficiency in its saving throws.

name: Revenant Blade
source: Eberron - Rising from the Last War
desc: Elf. +1 DEX or STR. +1 AC while wielding a double-bladed scimitar in two hands, which counts as finesse for you.

name: Righteous Heritor
prereq: 4th Level, Scion of the Outer Planes (Good Outer Plane) Feat.
desc: Needs Scion of the Outer Planes (good). +1 to any ability. Reaction: reduce damage to you or a creature within 30 ft by 1d10 + prof (prof bonus/long rest).

name: Ritual Caster
prereq: Intelligence or Wisdom of 13 or higher
desc: Needs INT or WIS 13. Ritual book with two 1st-level ritual spells from one class list; copy more rituals (level up to half yours, 2 h and 50 gp per level).

name: Rune Shaper
source: Bigby Presents - Glory of the Giants
prereq: Spellcasting Feature or Rune Carver Background
desc: Comprehend Languages free once per long rest. Know runes equal to half prof bonus; after a long rest inscribe them on objects to gain their 1st-level spells, each castable free once.

name: Savage Attacker
desc: Once per turn, reroll a melee weapon's damage dice and keep either total.

name: Scion of the Outer Planes
desc: Pick a kind of Outer Plane: a damage resistance and a cantrip (no material, INT, WIS or CHA) from the Planar Infusion table.

name: Second Chance
desc: Halfling. +1 DEX, CON or CHA. Reaction: a creature that hits you rerolls the attack; recharges on initiative or a rest.

name: Sentinel
desc: Opportunity attack hits drop speed to 0; Disengage doesn't stop your opportunity attacks; reaction attack on an adjacent creature that attacks someone else.

name: Servo Crafting
desc: Find Familiar as a ritual, the familiar a servo; telepathy and speech through it; give up one of your attacks for it to attack.

name: Shadow Touched
desc: +1 INT, WIS or CHA. Invisibility and one 1st-level illusion/necromancy spell, each free once per long rest.

name: Sharpshooter
desc: No disadvantage at long range, ignore half and three-quarters cover; with a proficient ranged weapon take -5 to hit for +10 damage.

name: Shield Master
desc: With a shield: bonus action shove after attacking, shield AC added to DEX saves vs effects targeting only you, reaction to take no damage on a successful DEX save for half.

name: Skill Expert
desc: +1 to any ability, one skill proficiency, expertise in one proficient skill.

name: Skilled
desc: Proficiency in any three skills or tools.

name: Skulker
desc: Needs DEX 13. Hide when lightly obscured; a missed ranged attack doesn't reveal you; dim light doesn't hinder sight-based Perception.

name: Slasher
desc: +1 STR or DEX. Once per turn a slashing hit cuts speed by 10 ft; a slashing crit gives the target disadvantage on attacks until your next turn.

name: Soul of the Storm Giant
source: Bigby Presents - Glory of the Giants
prereq: 4th Level, Strike of the Giants (Storm Strike) Feat
desc: +1 STR, WIS or CHA. Bonus action 10 ft aura until your next turn: lightning/thunder resistance, attacks against you at disadvantage, creatures starting there STR save or half speed (prof bonus/long rest).

name: Spell Sniper
prereq: The ability to cast at least one spell
desc: Needs spellcasting. Attack-roll spells reach twice as far and ignore half and three-quarters cover; learn one attack cantrip.

name: Squat Nimbleness
desc: Dwarf or Small race. +1 STR or DEX, +5 ft speed, Acrobatics or Athletics, advantage on checks to escape a grapple.

name: Squire of Solamnia
source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen
prereq: Dragonlance Campaign, Fighter or Paladin Class or Knight of Solamnia Background
desc: Mounting costs 5 ft. Once per turn give a weapon attack advantage; on a hit +1d8 damage (prof bonus uses per long rest, spent only on hits).

name: Strike of the Giants
source: Bigby Presents - Glory of the Giants
prereq: Martial Weapon Proficiency or Giant Foundling Background
desc: Pick a giant kind. Once per turn on a melee or thrown weapon hit: extra damage plus that giant's rider (prone, push, slow, invisibility...) (prof bonus/long rest).

name: Strixhaven Initiate
desc: Pick a Strixhaven college: two cantrips and one 1st-level spell from its table, the spell free once per long rest (INT, WIS or CHA).

name: Strixhaven Mascot
desc: Needs Strixhaven Initiate. Find Familiar as a ritual with your college's mascot; give up an attack for it to attack; action to swap places with it within 60 ft, once per long rest or with a 2nd+ slot.

name: Svirfneblin Magic
desc: Deep gnome. Nondetection on yourself at will; Blindness/Deafness, Blur and Disguise Self once each per long rest (INT).

name: Tavern Brawler
desc: +1 STR or CON, proficiency with improvised weapons, d4 unarmed strikes, bonus action grapple after an unarmed or improvised hit.

name: Telekinetic
desc: +1 INT, WIS or CHA. Mage Hand without components, invisible if you like (+30 ft if known). Bonus action: STR save or a creature within 30 ft is moved 5 ft.

name: Telepathic
desc: +1 INT, WIS or CHA. One-way telepathy 60 ft in a language you know; Detect Thoughts free once per long rest.

name: Tough
desc: Hit point maximum +2 per level.

name: Vampiric Exultation
desc: Action: misty lower body, 30 ft flying speed for up to 10 min, once per short rest.

name: Vigor of the Hill Giant
source: Bigby Presents - Glory of the Giants
prereq: 4th Level, Strike of the Giants (Hill Strike) Feat
desc: +1 STR, CON or WIS. Reaction to avoid being moved or knocked prone; eating on a short rest adds CON + prof to HP from Hit Dice.

name: War Caster
prereq: The ability to cast at least one spell
desc: Needs a spell. Advantage on concentration saves, somatic components with hands full, a single-target 1-action spell instead of an opportunity attack.

name: Weapon Master
desc: +1 STR or DEX, proficiency with four simple or martial weapons.

name: Wood Elf Magic
desc: Wood elf. A druid cantrip; Longstrider and Pass without Trace once each per long rest (WIS).
